jurisdiction.venue: Southwark Crown Court & UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)

headline: Working From Home Offered Flexibility, Including Minutes Between Confidential Emails and Leveraged Bets
deck: Ex-Janus Henderson analyst Redinel Korfuzi and his sister drew a record 11 combined years for £1 million in remote insider trades and 173 cash deposits.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: Record 11 combined years prison (132 months) for ~£1M insider trading and money laundering — an unusually stern white-collar benchmark.
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: 12–24 months custody; here, an individual analyst received far stiffer prison time than banks fined billions

sources.title: Redinel and Oerta Korfuzi Sentenced to Combined 11 Years for Insider Dealing and Money Laundering

interactive_art_spec.caption: Southwark Crown Court in London, where Redinel and Oerta Korfuzi received the Financial Conduct Authority’s longest combined insider-trading sentence.
